text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle is 1st!! A complete and total 
comeback for K.S. Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Putting on a show of overwhelming speed to 
seize the victory is K.S. Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaahhh...!! That was soooo much fun, 
buuut...!! Miracle, you're, way, too, 
faaast...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you were passed out just a 
bit ago...!! Or rather, weren't you even 
faster than before you collapsed!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, just how fast are you gonna 
get—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To the ends of the earth, it seems. 
...That person.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...!! Alright... Alright...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Right, everyone is—)

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Kei-chan...! Congratulations, 
congratulations! Congratulations on 1st 
place...!!

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
How fast you are... You worked so hard. 
...You're incredible. ...I'm so proud of 
you...!!

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
You ran so well! Absolutely magnificent!! 
You did so well... to run like that for 
us.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Everyone......

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Ah... She looks so happy.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That's why, I have to too. After all, I 
need to...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I'm glad.)

Having returned to the waiting room, K.S. 
Miracle let out a slow, long, delicate 
breath—

Then, with a somewhat refreshed look on 
her face, she told me this.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Both of them are true.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"This is how I repay my debt of gratitude. 
It's something I have to do—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even so, it's what I want to do after all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"If I didn't get results, if I didn't 
repay everyone... I could never forgive 
myself."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I absolutely had to do it. 
That's the truth."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
However— I just want to say "thank you" 
through my running.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That I'm totally fine now. That I can even 
win an amazing race, and that every single 
bit of it is thanks to everyone.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's true, that really is what I wanted to 
say.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Because, after all... I was happy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Earlier. When I won, and saw everyone so 
genuinely happy for me. I really was... 
the happiest I've ever been.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I want to make them even 
happier. I want to see them smile even, 
even more...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why, moving forward too... I'm 
still doing this to 'pay back what I owe.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To give back miracles to everyone who made 
a miracle happen for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to run and keep moving forward.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's keep doing that, together.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"And then, naturally... the one I really 
want to claim is the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Next spring, huh... We still have a little 
time left. Taking it slow to build up 
strength sounds nice too, but—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Theeeen wanna run with us!?!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: W-Whoa, Helios...! Wait—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: 'Sup!! Pardon the intrusion!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo! What's the matter with you two? 
What do you mean, running...?

text_block_list.name: Helios & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship (it is)!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I figured she'd make a comeback, but... 
...To be honest, she totally got the 
better of me today!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Miracle. For all my talk, I completely 
underestimated your guts.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it really hit home today!! That's 
why—I wanna surpass you!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm challenging you to a rematch, ss! One 
more time at the Mile Championship!! 
Please run with us again, ss!!!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Revenge... Is that how it is for you too, 
Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Nope! I just had soooo much fun today 
that I wanna run one more time! ☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: *Faceplants!!*

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Helios, seriously...! You're, like, 
so totally you...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes☆ As if I could ever be anyone else! 
No way, no how!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But like~ wanting to run with Mira-pyon is 
for. real.♡

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mai-chan, won'tcha come?! Miracle's 
comin' too, right? FYI, the young lady 
ain't comin'!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby too... I see.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. Can I... run? Is it okay?"
choice_data_list: Got it, let's get it adjusted.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you so much. Well then—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo, Helios. ...Let's run together 
again.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Next, at the Mile CS.
